=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:76-80 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The sweep fetches only the first 100 open PRs because it uses `per_page=100` without pagination.
  WHY: Repositories with more than 100 open non-draft PRs will silently miss later PRs, contradicting the sweep's promise to target every open non-draft PR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:79-80 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The PR-enumeration `gh api` call is not wrapped in `gh_retry`.
  WHY: A transient GitHub/API failure on the initial PR fetch can abort the whole sweep under `set -euo pipefail`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:126-131 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The active-run preflight uses bare `gh api` and falls back to `0` on error.
  WHY: Transient API failures are treated as “no active run,” so the sweep can dispatch a duplicate review on top of an already-running one.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:88-91 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The active-run preflight checks only the first 10 workflow runs per workflow.
  WHY: Older queued or in-progress runs can be missed, allowing duplicate dispatches.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:120-125 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The preflight checks only `internal-review.yml` and `review_autofix.yml`, omitting `ai-review.yml`.
  WHY: Repos that use `ai-review.yml` can have an active run the sweep does not see, and the sweep may dispatch on top of it.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:330-331 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The comment references the non-existent workflow name `internal-review-autofix-sweep`.
  WHY: Operators searching for that name will not find the actual workflow file or display name.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4627-4627 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The mirror-guard comment still says `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED=false` is the opt-out action after the default flip.
  WHY: The comment no longer reflects the new default and can mislead operators about the correct configuration knob.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4627-4630 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The post-commit mirror guard defaults `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED` to `true` while the gate defaults it to `false`.
  WHY: Reviewers ranged from high to critical on this mismatch; when the variable is unset, the gate and mirror path interpret the config differently, so productive autofix commits can be skipped in the mirror path even though the gate allowed them.
- README.md:70-74 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The README still describes the old `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED` semantics after the default flip.
  WHY: Operators can be misled into setting the wrong value or misunderstanding the default behavior.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:73-75 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The permissions block omits `actions:read`.
  WHY: In restricted repos, the token may lack the read access needed for the workflow-run API calls, causing preflight to fail and the sweep to skip PRs.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
